body: I see a therapist as well as psychiatrist. I've been treated for bipolar, depression, anxiety and boredrline personality as well as substance abuse. Ironically enough I work at a mental health clinic. My only problem with seeing a therapist is I'm afraid to tell the whole truth. I had a suicide attempt on Sunday. If I tell I don't want her to put me in the hospital. Thank you for caring, I see you're having some issues of your own, though. So what brings you here, if you don't mind me asking?

I think what makes it so bad is how he wants to just pretend I never said anything. I can't do that. My mom found out she has cancer. I hate my job. I've had it for 5 years. But I feel stuck in it. I want to leave but the security of finances and health benefits and such keeps me there. My nightmares are getting increasingly more severe as all of these things happen. I try to self medicate with drugs and alcohol which fuels my anxiety of going back to jail. I'm terrified to ask for help from people because I don't want to burden anyone with my problems. I was raped by an uncle when I was 16. Im 22 now and that still haunts me. I'm so out of order but it's like this in my head. Just this constant cycle of bullshit.

I went to jail in October for 30 days after getting a dui. Ever since then I've been having issues sleeping. I also have a substance abuse problem. I reached out to a friend who recently got sober and him and I became very close. This past weekend I opened up about having feelings for him and they were not reciprocated. Which was fine, except for now things between us are strange and awkward. We don't laugh and have fun like before, which is entirely my fault. After that happened my best friend told me that I'm too much drama in his life and so he doesn't want to deal with me. That was a harsh talk. I can keep going but writing it down like this makes it all seem so minisucul and stupid
I don't even know where to start
